the effects of nicotine on the expression of HSP and VEGF during perinatal lung development.

the expression of HSP and VEGF is upregulated by nicotine in the lung parenchymal tissue of the neonatal rat.

nicotine exposure during pregnancy can increase the expression of VESF and HSP 70 in the lung of rat offspring.
nicotine exposure during gestational days 10‐21 in rats increases VEGF and heat shock protein 70 (HSP70) expression, which may contribute to the pathogenesis of hypoxemic pulmonary hypertension.
